newsitem.title: USA: Mobil shuts in 4 U.S. Gulf fields due storm.
newsitem.headline: Mobil shuts in 4 U.S. Gulf fields due storm.

text.p: Mobil Corp said it shut in production in four of its offshore fields in the Gulf of Mexico because of the tropical storm Danny, which is heading toward the Louisiana coast.

A Mobil spokesman would not give production levels for the fields -- Eugene Island 240, Green Canyon 18/60, Ship Shoal 72 and Ship Shoal 182 -- though they are among the smaller of the fields in those systems.
"We have evacuated all personnel and the fields have been shut in," the spokesman said.
A number of rigs have been evacuated and oil and gas fields shut in as the storm heads toward the offshore production areas.
